purpose: Supplement the near-boundary step scan with actual nested refinement of every frozen cell; examine accumulated Bellman tie tolerance.
reason: With fixed geometric growth 1.2, reducing inner_step alone need not shrink every far-field cell. It is not a uniform-mesh convergence sequence.
base_grid: Exactly propagation.api.make_grid(), already frozen at 56 active cells.
physical_cases: All physical parameter cases and all 54 first-hit cases from VALIDATION_PROTOCOL.json.
actions: All 72 independent contexts and inherited witness from VALIDATION_PROTOCOL.json; same R12 observation law and same root tolerance controller.
reference: Finite 224-active-cell model formed by quartering each frozen cell. This remains a finite reference, not an analytic continuum solution.
tie_bound: Use H*tau for a policy computed with tolerance at each of H Bellman levels; a local Q-vector check is not a full reachable-state policy regret bound.
discrete_renewal_sanity: Compare fast/slow quantized exponential phases against an independent four-state expm with exactly zero active excursion duration, at T=2.1, retention=.75, recovery=.35, steps128/256/512.
confirmation: No confirmation data, fitted efficacy results or task outcome generation. Frozen runtime files remain unchanged.
